result.keyword: What's the best password manager for a small team?
result.markdown:
For most small teams, I'd recommend **1Password or Bitwarden**\.

- **1Password** is the best overall choice if you prioritise ease of use, polished apps and straightforward team management.
- **Bitwarden** is the best value if you want strong security and team features without spending too much.

Here's how I'd compare the main options.

## Best password managers for small teams

![Wachtwoordmanager 1Password | KPN](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/SR9cQiLQIFEFCALVJ5nUtWe25Q29qJVc5LjX65WdCnj5yzmD0dY1kGYKRcHN2028gLjEDLJ1Kkz4elZpmKF_3nFRDEJ56EPcrV1LwREU1riSDOE2qPsulZBrm1uLMFbZk3uGppXxaiJ5LZXh3ClEqc5wBJ1jJuMVahqzv5wwpeyD20eaUwi0i3WuDMRbtYuK?purpose=fullsize)

**1\. 1Password**

(Best overall)

# \$24.95/month

Teams Starter Pack, up to 10 users

- Excellent user experience.
- Shared vaults and granular permissions.
- Easy onboarding and offboarding.
- Good admin and security controls.

Best for teams that want something everyone will actually use.

[1Password business plans](https://1password.com/business)

---

![The best password managers in 2026 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/NzVuMgIchg5mHs-Kr9143cu9YVcLD78U-cfqnnpzpdksR6kB5LPVR6OyqUe0J0PAWilFgVX5RafeZ-AzNa_G6WUPgI8J1U4oAahEfqnQQL2SaxhVwFg9jy1o1kVewXMyq40iQ1cCkpkzpsh_DQntfgs6e3PLRpQFbO3dRcV-HQGbTSkVwYxuDvCJM657Aw6_?purpose=fullsize)

**2\. Bitwarden**

(Best value)

# \$4/user/month

Teams plan, annual billing

- Open-source core.
- Shared collections and organisation management.
- Audit and event logs.
- Directory integration.
- Self-hosting options at the appropriate tier.

Best for technically minded teams and budget-conscious businesses.

[Bitwarden business plans](https://bitwarden.com/business/)

---

![Keeper Security Logo PNG,  Vector (AI, EPS, CDR, PDF, SVG) - iconLogoVector](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/hjZLLtGaZjkKvsDiCoIrNA749yx3vMYIFoRmmV0blB-pAj7O30nu3RJOVVhVRwgAOkJUfJ3datZ7pfH1wp7yeplrEL3FQ-HNOpCzlVOW0OcMr1CFjIFAx50apRkdH6sYOH31WcP6gfXOxeAN8qubYhHhGYA5yXp1bc7wqtCxjN2WEQuyMALTG1Pwne14BXyG?purpose=fullsize)

**3\. Keeper**

(Best for administration)

- Strong administrative controls.
- Shared team folders.
- Role-based permissions.
- Additional security and compliance features.

Good if you have more demanding security requirements.

[Keeper business plans](https://www.keepersecurity.com/business.html)

---

![The best password managers in 2025 | Tom's Guide](https://images.openai.com/static-rsc-4/S30I88layvxbkaDwXaWP5XnJ7U511ARCXJEcDjYd8i8QoMbXMBiKKYXroCriJ7kBR0oi7lM-NLlyOXMHqaLP4YKGj6rWlLsTvfSS4pKj24h_up7wZjWKu6xYF8rT-_7bc8XbvU4PlaIDiwcj88cnT8GVhbZrDMRuBptQttvTl2oiFqpoAxV9-pe3un--FrSZ?purpose=fullsize)

**4\. Proton Pass**

(Best for privacy)

- Privacy-focused approach.
- Shared vaults.
- Passkey support.
- Useful email alias features.

Worth considering if privacy and European data protection are priorities.

[Proton Pass for Business](https://proton.me/business/pass)

Indicative prices in USD, excluding taxes, based on November 2026 comparisons. Check current regional pricing before purchasing. [toolsandthrive.com](https://toolsandthrive.com/best-password-manager-for-small-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[www.softwarecompare.net](https://www.softwarecompare.net/comparison/best-password-manager-for-business?utm_source=chatgpt.com)[vettlo.com](https://vettlo.com/tools/best-password-managers-for-business/?utm_source=chatgpt.com)

## My recommendation

For a typical small business\:

| Team size | My recommendation |
|--------|--------|
| 2–5 people | 1Password |
| 5–15 people | 1Password or Bitwarden |
| 15–50 people | Bitwarden or 1Password Business |
| Technical team | Bitwarden |
| Privacy-focused business | Proton Pass |


## What I'd insist on having

Regardless of which product you choose, make sure it supports\:

1. **Shared vaults\:** Share credentials without sending passwords over Slack or email.
2. **Individual accounts\:** Never have everyone using one master account.
3. **Access permissions\:** Restrict access to sensitive credentials.
4. **Offboarding\:** Immediately revoke access when someone leaves.
5. **2FA\:** Require two-factor authentication.
6. **Audit logs\:** Know who accessed or changed shared credentials.

## Three questions to narrow it down

I'd like to narrow this down to the best fit rather than just recommend the most popular product.

**1\. How many people are on your team?**
